hints.title: Local Monotonicity Accumulation
hints.text: A day qualifies if it is preceded by at least time non-increasing steps and followed by at least time non-decreasing steps.

hints.title: Bidirectional Prefix Scans
hints.text: Compute left[i] as the run length of non-increasing values ending at i, and right[i] starting at i.

hints.title: Threshold Intersection
hints.text: Iterate across valid center indices and filter for indices where both left[i] and right[i] are at least time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) prefix and suffix consecutive count arrays
complexity.notes: Track consecutive non-increasing days ending at index i and consecutive non-decreasing days starting at index i.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking the window around every day takes O(N * time) which degrades to quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two linear scans cache monotonicity lengths for instant lookup at each day.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute left non-increasing and right non-decreasing counts with dynamic programming.
